name: notification-center-01
title: Notification Center 01 - A List Of Notifications With An Unread Count
description: A list of notifications where each carries a mark, a title, a body, a moment, a read state and a per item action slot, with the unread count computed from the items and the words for it handed back through a function, because three unread, three new and three since Monday are three sentences. An unread item carries a filled dot that is also a graphic with the caller own name, because a colour is not a state a screen reader can be told about, and read is derived from each item own field and never from the count. Two shapes: a page section, or a bounded panel for a shell.
